Design.evidence_source: subjects took part only in one session. Participants were recruited using the ORSEE software (Greiner, 2004). The experiment was programmed and conducted with the software z-Tree (Fischbacher, 2007) and took, on average, 50 minutes. The average earnings in the experiment have been e7.61 or $10.65. The show-up fee for the experiment was e2.50 or $3.50. Upon arrival at the laboratory subjects were randomly assigned to one of the computer terminals.

country.evidence_source: 90 participants were recruited among students from various disciplines at the local university.
country.warning: The specific country of the 'local university' is not mentioned in this section.
